title: Add typed diagram nodes and semantic edges
summary: Without typed nodes, ports and edges, moving a node breaks connectors and diagrams cannot distinguish navigation, dependency, ownership or data flow. Add typed diagram nodes, ports, semantic edges, orthogonal routing baseline, labels and deterministic serialization on top of BoardCore.
acceptance_criteria: BoardCore defines typed DiagramNode, Port and SemanticEdge payloads without coupling them to SwiftUI views.
Edges attach to ports and remain connected when nodes move, resize, group or change z-order.
The first router supports deterministic straight and orthogonal paths with visible fallback when no clean route exists.
Edges support labels and at least navigation, dependency, ownership and data-flow semantics.
Keyboard-accessible commands create, reconnect and delete edges; invalid self or duplicate relationships follow documented policy.
Serialization and geometry tests cover port resolution, node movement, routing and missing-node recovery.
The existing imported navigation map can be projected into read-only Board diagram objects without losing trigger/type metadata.

evidence.note: Imported views already expose semantic navigation targets.
The current web navigation map renders a narrow set of semantic edge types.
ViewItem already retains navigation target, trigger and type metadata.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.
